title: Preventing SQL injection
body: What is the primary defence against SQL injection?

options.t: Parameterised queries / prepared statements (or an ORM that parameterises)

explanation: Add least-privilege database accounts and input validation as defence in depth; never build SQL by string concatenation with user input.

title: Preventing XSS
body: Which measures best prevent cross-site scripting (XSS)?

options.t: Context-aware output encoding (as frameworks like React and Razor do by default) plus a Content Security Policy

explanation: Danger zones: `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, `Html.Raw`. Sanitise rich HTML with a vetted library and mark session cookies HttpOnly.

title: CSRF mitigation
body: Which mitigates cross-site request forgery for cookie-authenticated apps?
explanation: CSRF abuses the browser automatically attaching cookies. APIs authenticated with bearer tokens in the Authorization header are not vulnerable to classic CSRF.

title: Storing passwords

options.t: Encrypted with AES so they can be recovered
Hashed with a slow, salted algorithm such as PBKDF2, bcrypt or Argon2
In plain text in a secure database

explanation: Fast hashes (MD5, SHA-256) are brute-forced quickly on GPUs. ASP.NET Core Identity uses PBKDF2 with a per-user salt and many iterations.

title: Validating JWTs
body: Which JWT validation step is essential to prevent token forgery?

options.t: Verifying the signature with the expected key and algorithm, plus issuer, audience and expiry

answer: Verify signature (pinning the algorithm), issuer, audience and lifetime.
explanation: Never accept `alg: none` or let the token choose the algorithm; reject tokens with unexpected issuers or audiences.

title: Least privilege
body: What does the principle of least privilege mean?

options.t: Give every user admin rights to avoid support tickets
Grant each user, service and process only the permissions required for its task

explanation: Applies to database accounts, cloud IAM roles, API scopes and container users (run as non-root).
